title: The completion verb works and no document mentions it
foundBy: session agent, following README.md and INSTALL.md as a first-time reader

evidence.verified: `cs-vcr completion bash | head -1` prints the bash completion header. MANUAL.md now carries the verb in its synopsis and a section with the two ways to install the script.

details:
`cs-vcr completion bash|zsh|fish|powershell` writes a completion script to stdout. MANUAL.md is "every command, option, file and diagnostic" by the README's doc map, and named every verb but this one, so the only way to find it was `--help`.

The sandbox repository documents its equivalent in both its manual and its install page.
